name: Hoarfrost Hookcrook
description: Stands with both hook swords crossed low before the belly, ready to open outward in a paired motion.

name: Clevisscourge
description: Opens a duel with a short left-hand cut at the enemy's guard hand, testing his reaction.

name: Silt Hookhilt
description: Enters on two even steps, each foot landing as one hook leads, so the pair stays balanced.

name: Ponderous Hooklock
description: Folds both hooks round an enemy sword from opposite sides and holds it stiff with qi.

name: Adamantine Hookend
description: Parries a cut with one hook as the other mirrors the motion, covering both flanks.

name: Mastering Cresthook
description: Tugs a weapon arm out of line with one beard while the other hook slices the exposed ribs.

name: Fastening Snarl
description: Pulls an opponent's guard wide with matched hooks and drives the right point through the opening.

name: Intent Pulldown
description: Cuts down two separate lines at once so the opponent cannot parry both without dropping a guard.

name: Shattering Yank Scourge
description: Closes both hooks on the opponent's arms as they converge on a single point, driving the sword through the trapped guard.

name: Aegiscleat
description: Drops into a deep crouch with the hooked tip high at the back, coiled like a hawk before the dive.

name: Might Hookspine
description: Springs forward from the crouch and chops down on the shoulder with the full drop of the body.

name: Meteoric Hookcurve
description: Springs backward with the arms flung wide, hooks out, so any pursuer meets a point.

name: Adamantine Hooktip
description: Checks a thrust with a flick of the talon-like hook and recovers to the perch.

name: Gyve Hookguard
description: Clamps the hook on a sword's guard and tears it up and away with a twist of the qi-charged wrist.

name: Equipoise Hookneck
description: Rises on a lifting parry that sends the enemy blade up and carries the user over it.

name: Tempered Swordhook
description: Reaches far past an opponent's guard with the hooked tip, striking the shoulder from above.

name: Gyvedisarm
description: Drops the hook over a sword arm, locks the elbow and pins the blade hand against the ground.

name: Shadecleat
description: Circles overhead of the foe in darting dives that rake with the hook and retreat.

name: Piercing Cresthook
description: Launches from the crouch in a single flashing dive and sinks the barb through armor before the foe can raise a guard.

name: Charter Hookhilt
description: Cups both hooks before the chest like hands holding water, the guards turned up to catch a cut.

name: Gustcleat
description: Lets one hook tip over and spill forward in a short downward cut at the collarbone.

name: Gustyank
description: Walks a narrow line like a riverbank, the hooks balanced out to each side.

name: Gyve Hookcrook
description: Leans away from a thrust and hooks the sleeve as the enemy arm passes.

name: Aegis Hookspine
description: Rolls both swords in front of the body like a shifting sandbar, wearing a blow down to nothing.

name: Gyve Swordhook
description: Wraps a hook in tightening circles around the wrist, drawing it deeper into the bend with each turn.

name: Iron Disarm
description: Joins a cutting stroke to a pulling one, as two streams run into one.

name: Indomitable Hookguard
description: Receives a blade at the crossing of both hooks, turns it, and cuts down the open flank.

name: Numbing Disarm
description: Hooks both ankles and drags the opponent backward under the guard like an undertow.

name: Hour Pulldown
description: Raises hook after hook in climbing cuts that fill the space and press the enemy back.

name: Snarlvalor
description: Circles both hooks to wind the opponent's blade into a bound basin of steel, flowing wherever he tries to draw it out.

name: Hookcurve Obduracy
description: Aligns both hooks along a single line before the body so the opponent sees only one blade.

name: Tempered Twistaway
description: Thrusts from behind the front hook with the rear blade, so two points arrive close together.

name: Granite Yank
description: Steps behind the front hook's line and uses it as cover while closing.

name: Fastening Hookend
description: Draws an enemy blade along the single line and into the bend so it follows the pull without resistance.

name: Might Twistaway
description: Holds the rear hook behind the front so a surprise cut arrives from the veiled side.

name: Enthralling Hookneck
description: Splits the single line into two suddenly and disrupts the enemy's read of the angle.

name: Tempered Hooktip
description: Drives both tips through one hole in the guard in rapid succession, widening the wound.

name: Clevismettle
description: Retreats along the line with hooks trailing so the pursuer runs onto both bends.

name: Hollowcleat
description: Returns an enemy thrust along the line it came by, doubling its force through both hooks into his own chest.

name: Facet Hookspine
description: Stands with one hook leading a straight track and the other trailing a curved one.

name: Tempered Hooklock
description: Jabs straight with the leading point, drawing the enemy's guard to the one line.

name: Iron Hookguard
description: Draws the trailing hook round in a curve to cut the side the jab left open.

name: Phantom Yank
description: Skips from one track to the other mid-stride so the angle of attack swaps.

name: Unbudging Swordhook
description: Braids the two hooks over each other in a parry that carries any cut off to the ground.

name: Fastening Hooktip
description: Sends one hook straight and the other round so they meet behind the enemy's wrist and close.

name: Fastening Hookneck
description: Pulls on both of the enemy's arms in parallel, spreading the guard until the chest opens.

name: Murkgrapnel
description: Swaps the roles of both hooks in mid-parry, so the guard becomes the cut and the cut the guard.

name: Gyve Hookend
description: Lays two overlapping hook lines across a doorway-wide space so any entrance catches an arm or leg.

name: Thorndisarm
description: Seizes one arm on the straight track and strikes the heart on the curved one.

name: Granite Hookcrook
description: Pours strokes down both tracks in turn, never repeating an angle, until the enemy's guard tires.

name: Fastening Pulldown
description: Weaves both hooks into a net of two tracks that closes on every sword in reach and holds all of them still.

name: Charter Hookcurve
description: Stands wide and low like a river entering the sea, hooks spread open to either side.

name: Corroding Twistaway
description: Cuts low across the shins like a silt bar across a channel, stopping an advance.

name: Might Hookhilt
description: Fans out into three short steps in different directions, confusing the foe's aim.

name: Toxin Snarl
description: Checks the enemy's forward arm in a narrow channel between hook and guard.

name: Torrent Cresthook
description: Parries in a growing arc that widens as the cut presses, taking its force out sideways.

name: Hoarfrost Disarm
description: Drags an enemy sword slowly across his own body with a slow pull that tires the wrist.

name: Unsparing Disarm
description: Hooks the arm and slices along it in one outgoing motion, widening toward the shoulder.

name: Overbearing Snarl
description: Catches an arm in the hook and throws the opponent out and away in one broad stroke.

name: Hookend Ruin
description: Surges forward in thick overwhelming cuts that flood every opening the foe leaves.

name: Iron Hooklock
description: Sweeps out in an ever-widening spiral of hook cuts that opens every guard along its width and carries the foe out.

name: Cresthook Spine
description: Fills the chest with a held breath in a high guard, the hooked tip raised like a beak.

name: Merciless Snarl
description: Pecks the point at the face and throat in short quick jabs.

name: Ghosting Hookguard
description: Settles on one foot and then the other, light as a bird on a branch, ready to launch.

name: Irongrapnel
description: Releases the held breath in a short shout and a sudden cut that startles the enemy's guard.

name: Gust Hookspine
description: Clasps an enemy blade in the hook as in a talon and turns it harmlessly aside.

name: Decimating Hooktip
description: Climbs inside the enemy's reach in a rising sweep and cuts at the rising shoulder.

name: Hoarfrost Twistaway
description: Sinks the hooked tip into the wrist or forearm and twists to open the muscles.

name: Shattering Hookhilt
description: Chains dives and climbs across the foe's flanks, striking from above and slipping away below.

name: Grapnelhavoc
description: Shouts to freeze the foe's guard for a single beat and hooks the talon through it into the heart.

name: Obdurate Swordhook
description: Stands loosely with the hook held to the wind, ready to turn with any change of it.

name: Hellish Hookcrook
description: Brushes the hooked point across the arm in a light cut that stings and draws a flinch.

name: Blinding Yank
description: Advances with a lean as though pushed by a wind from behind, hook trailing level.

name: Grapneldurance
description: Turns the guard blade with the first change of the wind and lets the cut slip.

name: Webbing Pulldown
description: Veers the hook sideways at the last instant to catch a blade the enemy thought free.

name: Lacerating Hooklock
description: Replies to a cut with three quick strokes of the hook arriving like a sudden squall.

name: Thornclevis
description: Pulls an enemy sword wide in a long drawn arc and cuts the arm that follows.

name: Cleatvalor
description: Hooks the guard from the side and tears it out as the point drives in behind.

name: Cleatwrath
description: Builds blow on blow like a rising gale until the foe can no longer hold his line.

name: Enthralling Snarl
description: Dissolves into a rush of motion, hooks the enemy's weapon arm from the wind side and tears it open.

name: Grapnelmettle
description: Holds the hooked tip level on a bearing drawn through the enemy's centre.

name: Hookhilt Scourge
description: Extends the full arm and blade to strike at the very edge of reach, well beyond the foe's guard.

name: Phantom Hookspine
description: Backs away down the same bearing, the point never leaving the enemy's chest.

name: Overpowering Hookneck
description: Snares an enemy blade on the bearing and holds it from sliding off line.

name: Rumble Hookguard
description: Turns a quarter-circle on the held bearing and cuts the new side.

name: Inexorable Hookneck
description: Corrects a drifting parry back onto the bearing in mid-stroke, catching the blade it first missed.

name: Ponderous Swordhook
description: Hooks a distant enemy with the full reach and pulls him inside the bearing in a single drag.

name: Intentgrapnel
description: Hammers cuts down the one bearing without stepping off it, keeping the foe pinned to the line.

name: Nova Hookcrook
description: Hooks the enemy from beyond his own reach along the held bearing and drives the point home through the trapped arm.

name: Aegis Hookend
description: Stands tall on the balls of the feet with the hook raised in oath, then settles to a guard.

name: Hellish Pulldown
description: Chops down from a raised stance, using the height to add weight to the hooked blade.

name: Unseen Hookcurve
description: Walks a narrow line as along a ridge, turning only the shoulders as the hooks move.

name: Equipoise Cresthook
description: Blocks a cut with the guard blade while leaning out so the edge passes through empty air.

name: Aegis Hooktip
description: Holds the guard high over both hooks and stays still against a blow from below.

name: Hoarfrost Yank
description: Crosses both hooks over the enemy blade and locks it where it stands.

name: Maiming Hookguard
description: Pulls the hook sharply across and splits the enemy's grip as a crag is split by frost.

name: Sanguine Hookcurve
description: Slices the wrist in a clean cold stroke that the foe hardly feels until the hand opens.

name: Gyveyank
description: Hooks the lead ankle at the edge of a drop and tips the opponent off it.

name: Suffocating Disarm
description: Crosses both hooks over the foe's blade arm and thrusts the right point through the pinned elbow.

name: Granite Hooklock
description: Runs along an uninterrupted line of cuts that never drops below shoulder height.

name: Cleatspine
description: Locks both hooks onto the foe's weapons and holds the line against all comers as a sworn oath is held.

name: Facetcleat
description: Leans forward into the stance as a rider leans into the wind, hook held ready at the hip.

name: Hellish Cresthook
description: Cuts in the direction of a push from behind so the stroke carries extra speed.

name: Disarmvortex
description: Slides sideways across the enemy's line while the hook trails like a flag.

name: Cleatdurance
description: Checks a blade with a sharp gust of motion and turns the check into a step.

name: Cleatmettle
description: Hooks the enemy sword and rides the draw forward, using the pull to cross the gap.

name: Ponderous Hookspine
description: Snares a flapping sleeve in the hook and tugs the arm out of line.

name: Ironclevis
description: Shears across the body in one fast stroke that the wind seems to carry past the guard.

name: Nova Hooklock
description: Hooks the wrist from the windward side and cuts deep through the tendons on the pull.

name: Shade Yank
description: Advances with a wave of cuts like a storm front rolling across open ground.

name: Booming Snarl
description: Rides a surge of motion to the enemy's side and cuts through the exposed arm before it can turn.

name: Aegis Hookcrook
description: Plants both feet and holds the hook on a bearing fixed on the opponent's heart.

name: Hookneck Reckoning
description: Thrusts from the planted stance without shifting the feet, keeping the bearing steady.

name: Grapnelblink
description: Pivots in place on the ball of the foot, the hook never leaving its bearing.

name: Disarmnerve
description: Locks an enemy sword on the bearing with the hooked bend and keeps it steady.

name: Murkclevis
description: Parries with a smooth turn of the wrist that does not shake the line of the point.

name: Mangling Twistaway
description: Turns with the incoming blade like a vane, then cuts the arm along its own bearing.

name: Gyvegrapnel
description: Heaves a hooked opponent around the planted feet and into the ground with one turn of the hips.

name: Snarlscourge
description: Delivers cut after cut along one unshaken line so that the foe cannot find a safe side.

name: Overbearing Hoarfrost Hookhilt
description: Stands firm as the enemy's own force drives him onto the hook, the pull turning that force against him.

name: Granite Hookend
description: Stands lower than usual with the point turned down, looking for seams in plate and mail.

name: Mangling Pulldown
description: Pricks the hooked point into the seam of a breastplate at the arm joint.

name: Mightclevis
description: Probes with the tip beneath the gorget edge for the soft skin at the throat.

name: Gust Disarm
description: Steps forward heavily so the whole weight is behind the hook when it lands.

name: Equipoise Hooktip
description: Lets a heavy blow glance off the guard blade and sets the next strike on its line.

name: Twistaway Nerve
description: Catches the edge of a plate with the hook and pries it away from the body.

name: Wrathful Swordhook
description: Slices a buckle strap through with the inner curve of the hook and lets the plate fall.

name: Ponderous Hookcurve
description: Hauls on a helmet's rim with the hook and drags the head down into the waiting knee.

name: Rampaging Hookguard
description: Sets the barb in the rings of the mail and wrenches until they spring apart.

name: Snarl Durance
description: Pulls and strips plate after plate in a steady rhythm, leaving the wearer bare in a few breaths.

name: Gnashing Nova Pulldown
description: Anchors the barb in a seam and rips the armor open along a single drawn pull, leaving the wearer's flank exposed.

name: Clevisnerve
description: Salutes the opponent with the hooked tip held vertically, then sinks into a low ready guard.

name: Rampaging Hookcrook
description: Thrusts long and level, the whole body behind the point as the wind crosses the plateau.

name: Siltyank
description: Sidesteps with a short skip, hooks held away from the body like loose wings.

name: Torrent Hookhilt
description: Leans away from a swing and blocks it with the crescent guard at the last moment.

name: Cresthook Valor
description: Pulls the opposing blade to the edge of its swing and sends it spinning free.

name: Gust Hooktip
description: Feints a hooking pull and cuts across with the straight edge as the foe commits to resisting.

name: Snarlspine
description: Wraps the hook around a limb in a quick whirl and cuts it as the turn completes.

name: Disarm Wrath
description: Hooks upward under the ribs and pulls with the whole weight of the body, rending the flank.

name: Yank Reckoning
description: Sweeps hook cuts across open ground in all directions until no one stands inside the swing.

name: Eviscerating Hookspine Reckoning
description: Crosses the whole open plateau in one burst of motion and hooks the enemy's guard open before driving the point through it.
